verdict.rationale: Poke documents a single REST endpoint for sending messages and an `npx poke` CLI for tunneling MCP servers and creating recipes. Neither is an official SDK or client library; a raw API and a CLI are adjacent capabilities, not SDKs. The evidence never mentions any language SDK, package, or client library for building against Poke.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
